reviews.text: Dr. Zangheri is always attentive, caring and kind, and above all, very good.
If you have an exotic animal I highly recommend this clinic and Dr. Andrea

I don't know where to start... the clean environment, courtesy, and expertise are evident in every corner of the room. All the doctors are highly competent and patient. Obviously, you absolutely have to make an appointment because the area is large and full of furry friends to care for. So, it's understandable if you sometimes get turned down if you show up without an appointment. Especially since these infallible people are always on the move from opening to closing. I think it's understandable if sometimes their responses are "hasty," which isn't the case with all their little patients, because they go to great lengths if their little patient doesn't leave in the best condition.

I've been to this veterinary clinic several times, with appointments and, unfortunately, a few emergencies, and I can guarantee that no one has ever backed out or delegated to other clinics due to lack of time. So, to all the staff, I extend my heartfelt thanks.
Excellent clinic also for exotic animals
We bring our bunny here and we have a great time!
In July I found a kitten at the end of her life and Dr. Caterina was our angel. Without her the kitten would have died. Thank you always and infinitely.
I've always found Dr. Bassani to be very helpful and professional. He's a special person. I travel a few miles to get there, but it's time well spent.

I'll start by saying I went without an appointment... I didn't expect anything, I just had to squeeze the glands in my bottom (it takes 2 minutes, 5 minutes in total for the fee), I assume a doctor told me that I needed an appointment but to wait... After half an hour of waiting and with her passing by the waiting room continuously (so she saw me that I was there) she tells me that I have to leave because she doesn't have time in a bad way and that I had to make an appointment!!! After half an hour you send me away? After I waited, on top of all the half hour that my furry friend was shaking non-stop? Couldn't she have said it right away? I would have left, and in a terrible way too... If this is sensitivity it really leaves a lot to be desired... Comparing it with my vet who would never have behaved like this even if they are not his patients, it was only for the glands and he is on the other side of Rome that's why I didn't go, but after this it confirms my choice!!!
